name: Unidentified Carrack-class light cruiser
description: A Carrack-class light cruiser was owned by the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era. Sometime between 5 BBY and 4 BBY, the ship was abandoned in the Kryton system due to a technical mishap. The Spectres traveled to tag the Carrack-class light cruiser with a Rebel Alliance starbird in order to make the Empire think the Spectres did it.
